Type: Region (Body of Water)
First Visited: Session 0

Description

A vast freshwater inland sea fed by the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers}.
So large it functions as an inland ocean — the far shores are not visible from any single vantage point.
Multiple city-states and kingdoms line its shores.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s port town of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{Havens Reach} provides access to lake trade.
Accessible through the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.PEnF3AXmLA3UEGGO]{Cragmarr} via the river passages.
Multiple other kingdoms and city-states exist around the Solvium and beyond, none yet established.

Name

The name "Solvium" is of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium}-era origin.
Its meaning is debated — possibly derived from solus (alone) or solvere (to release).
Sailors and scholars disagree on the etymology.
Some believe it reflects the feeling of isolation experienced on its vast surface; others suspect the name predates common usage and holds deeper significance lost to history.

Notable Features

  • Hub of trade between multiple political entities
  • Fed by the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers}
  • Once a major artery of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.yAiIJMlC7flCgMRm]{Imperium} trade, connecting distant provinces

Connected Locations

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.3Fsz5CXjF9SwnyKx]{Eastern Rivers} — The rivers that feed the lake
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.PEnF3AXmLA3UEGGO]{Cragmarr} — The terrain between the lake and Beaconhold
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — Connected via @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{Havens Reach}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.5ieJV78RD0ZwDQRD]{Havens Reach} — Port town on the border between Beaconhold, the Eastern Rivers, and the Solvium

Events Here

  • Session 0 — Established as a major geographical feature
